# Copilot instructions for Anti Studio landing page

- Project goal: build a premium single-page interactive agency website in React + Vite with GSAP ScrollTrigger animation.
- Keep the experience black-and-white with pink accent treatments, generous spacing, oversized typography, and subtle motion.
- Preserve the app structure and avoid unrelated changes.
- Validate with a production build before finalizing.
- Preview locally with the Vite dev server using the localhost URL shown in the terminal.
- Keep accessibility in mind: respect reduced-motion settings and ensure links/buttons remain functional.
